articleTitle: Enhancing Lung Cancer Diagnosis with Machine Learning Methods and Systematic Review Synthesis
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ICEEIE)
abstract: Lung cancer is the leading cause of death in the USA It is caused for various reasons, such as malignant tumors that grow spontaneously in the lung and spread to other parts of the body, where they can be devastating. Other than that, there are so many external reasons why smoking is the primary factor that gradually creates lung problems that lead to lung cancer. However, we can prevent this deadly cancer by detecting it at an early stage. A machine learning-based detection model has the potential to detect lung cancer, which helps to predict the early stage of cancer. So, we aim to build some powerful machine learning algorithms to predict this cancer that can help physicians make decisions about the diagnosis process of a particular patient, whether the patient needs a high or a regular diagnosis level. This can reduce the treatment cost of a patient because the physician knows from the result how many doses are needed for a patient, so it can avoid unnecessary treatment, which saves money and brings an efficient diagnosis system. We aimed to build a sustainable model that could predict the disease accurately, and finally, our models, such as XGBoost, achieved the highest value of other models. According to the accuracy level, XGBoost performed up to 95.92%, LightGBM, AdaBoost, Logistic Regression, and Support vector machine achieved 91.50%, 93.32%, 57.41 %, and 89.32% accuracy, respectively.

articleTitle: Optimization of Performance Carbon-Based Nanolubricant on Ti6Al4V Pin on Disc Testing Using Taguchi Method
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ICEEIE)
abstract: Pin-on-disc (PoD) testing extensively to investigate material sliding behavior and relevant wear mechanisms under different tribological conditions, result of Pin on Disc testing is worn and coefficient of friction. To identify the optimal parameters of the Pin on Disc test can use the taguchi optimization method. Taguchi method is a reliable and cost-effective approach to optimization, especially when several factors may affect performance. Taguchi was chosen as the optimization method due to its reliability and the fact that it requires fewer experiments compared to other methods such as full factorial design. From the result optimization using Taguchi methods shows the best parameters for pin-on-disc testing using Taguchi. To reduce wear rate and friction coefficient by optimizing control parameters for pin-on-disc testing of material dry sliding wear behavior. Based on the S/N ratio of COF, it is known that the large load parameter has the highest influence on COF because it produces the highest delta value compared to other variables. This also shows that the optimal combination is to get the best COF value in the pin on disc test is oil type SWCNT, load 20N, and Speed 150 RPM. Based on the results of the response S/N ratio of wear, it is known that the large load parameter has the highest influence on wear because it produces the highest delta value compared to other variables. This also shows that the optimal combination is to get the best COF value in the pin on disc test is oil type SWCNT, load 20N, and Speed 120 RPM. The combination of SWCNT oil type, load 20 N and speed 120 RPM is the optimal parameter combination for COF and wear values. The results of ANOVA show that percentage load has the highest contribution of about 61.83%, and the other parameters have lower contributions.

articleTitle: Synchronization of the Internship Registration System using a Study Plan and Acceptance Letter Based on Tesseract-OCR and Template Matching
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ICEEIE)
abstract: SIMPI is an apprentice monitoring system in the Department of Electrical Engineering and Informatics that is un-connected between the academic system (SIAKAD) and the submission system of the internship letter. It often triggers verification errors for interns who have not registered internship in their study plan or do not have an internship acceptance letter. For this reason, we propose a modification of the registration that employs Tesseract-OCR (Optical Character Recognition) to generate text from an image of an acceptance letter while Template-Matching verifies Template Matching verifies student status in SIAKAD. Both methods prevent students' practices in the industry before finishing their registration on SIAKAD and obtaining an industrial acceptance letter. Method performance is measured based on error rate. The error rate based on the eligibility of interns reaches 0.09, while the error rate based on the legality of the letters reaches 0.16. Both results indicate that the proposed method can reject the registration of ineligible students and illegal document.

articleTitle: A Docker Container-Based Solution for Course Archival on Moodle: Implementation and Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ICEEIE)
abstract: Moodle, an abbreviation for Modular Object-Oriented Dynamic Learning Environment, is a web-based learning management system widely employed by educational institutions and campuses as a teaching and learning medium. As the operational activities and content of past courses accumulate over time, the volume of data increases, posing challenges for storage capacity. To address this issue, innovative data engineering approaches are necessary, particularly in the aspect of ICT infrastructure support, to effectively manage the rapid growth of data. In this study, the author aims to implement an archival system for storing and relocating past course content and activities, thereby alleviating the storage burden on the Moodle server. One viable approach is the utilization of Linux containers, such as Docker, wherein archived courses can be executed within a container. The experimental results demonstrate the successful placement of archived courses outside the server infrastructure of the organization's ICT, enabling cross-platform compatibility across Windows, Mac, and Linux operating systems.

articleTitle: Assisting Smart Tourism Through Virtual Reality Apps for Tourists Destination in Indonesia
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ICEEIE)
abstract: The tourism sector continues to adapt to technological advances. Starting from lack of recognition of halal tourism in Bali, it is necessary to have an effective and efficient promotional media in the development and promotion strategy. This study aims to develop a halal tourism information system assisted by virtual reality. This study used research and development (R&D) methods with the ADDIE model (Analysis, Design, Development, Implementation, Evaluation). This study found that BStations media is feasible to be used practically as a media for tourism promotion in Bali. Product development of this application can help tourists get tourist information quickly and easily, and can be used as an effective, efficient and sustainable strategy for promoting halal tourism in Bali.

articleTitle: Recurrence Multi Linear Regression of Historical Energy Supply for Energy Demand Forecaster
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ICEEIE)
abstract: An essential part of power system operation and management is day-ahead load forecasting. There is a consider-able impact of weather conditions and holidays on the daily load profile, and it follows a relatively similar pattern throughout the year. This paper describes a simple method to improve the daily forecasting accuracy of energy demand by comparing daily, weekly, monthly, and quarterly forecasting patterns. The model used to make predictions is multi-linear regression (MLR). This paper calls the method recurrence multi-linear regression because the forecasting pattern is carried out recursively. The proposed model has been compared with single linear regression (SLR) as a basic linear model, Gaussian process regression (GPR), and long short-term memory (LSTM). The error value of prediction concludes the performance evaluation from all models. The results show that the best model is the MLR, using weekly patterns for forecasting that can outperform the other models.

articleTitle: Acceptability Solar Power Plant Module as MOOC to Increasing Trainee's Technical Skill in Renewable Energy
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ICEEIE)
abstract: One of the new and renewable energy generators that has enormous potential is a solar power plant. Indonesia has a solar energy potential of 4.80 kWh/m2/day, so competent human resources are needed to manage this large enough energy source. Training is one way to improve work competence in the field of renewable energy generators. Based on the results of an interview with one of the companies providing the PV mini-grid training, it is known that there are no modules that can assist training activities and the number of participants that can be accommodated is limited. Development of a massive open online course (MOOC)-based training e-module which is expected to assist the training process and reach a wider range of participants. The availability of modules is expected to optimize the implementation of training in accordance with work competency standards in the field of new and renewable energy generation. Online training was chosen because in the current era it is more effective and efficient, so the modules needed for training are in the form of electronic modules or e-modules. This research will compare developing of module MOOC-based that is in accordance with National Job Competency Standards. The training e-module developed contains material about solar power plants (On Grid System, Off Grid System and Hybrid System). Based on the trials conducted, it was obtained (1) the results of expert validation got a percentage of; (2) the results of product trials get a percentage of % with an average summative test score of 83.60; and (3) the results of the use test obtained a percentage of 89.12% with an average summative test score of 87.65. Based on these results it can be concluded that the MOOC-based PLTS hybrid system training e-module can be declared feasible to use.

articleTitle: Microcontroller Based Sitting Position Detection System Using Decision Tree Method
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ICEEIE)
abstract: The purpose of this research is to use a decision tree to create a system that can identify when a person is seated. The premise behind the sitting position detector is a technology that can identify a sitting position and warn employees if they are sitting in an unsafe manner. The proposed system makes use of the APDS 9960 sensor, the ESP 32 controller, the DFMini Player media player, and the Whatsapp messaging service to alert the user. The individual is asked to adopt a variety of seated postures in order to obtain the data necessary to construct the decision tree. Good position, lean to the right, lean to the left, slightly inclined forward, slightly lean to the right, slightly lean to the left, very lean forward, very lean to the right, very lean to the left, and no one on the chair are all positions the subject may be asked to perform. The information is used to create a decision tree and assess its efficacy. The decision tree has a high degree of accuracy (98.52%). The f1-score, recall, and precision of the decision tree are above 95 %. These results suggest that the decision tree method utilized for system implementation. The system's position detection accuracy is 93.33% on the hardware implementation. The overall results of the testing indicate that the sitting position detecting system is functional.

articleTitle: Detection of Catastrophic Faults in 6-Bit R-2R Ladder DAC
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ICEEIE)
abstract: This paper studies the problem of finding a high coverage minimum test set for a 6-bit R-2R ladder Digital-to-Analog Converter (DAC). DAC is a versatile component that is used in several applications such as audio and video systems, telecommunication, and digital processing. The focus of the paper is on DC testing for catastrophic faults. Regarding the fault model, a transistor is assumed to have five possible faults while a resistor has two faults. It is shown that only 3 test vectors out of the 64 input vectors are needed to detect 82 out of the 84 faults with a test coverage of 97.62%.

articleTitle: Monitoring and Control System for Mesh Type Grounding Resistance in Medium Voltage Portal Substations
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ICEEIE)
abstract: Grounding is essential for the safety of people and electrical equipment. in general, the grounding system is only buried without any grounding resistance control system. grounding resistance can change slightly according to the season, because during the rainy season the soil becomes moist, and vice versa, during the dry season the soil conditions become dry and cause an increase in grounding resistance. In this research, a device is designed that can monitor and control grounding resistance automatically, by injecting water into the grounding location. The control used is Hysteresis ON/OFF type. The device is designed with the specifications of resistance measuring area 0.1 - 500 W, and effective error < 1 %. The resistance measurement method uses the 3-pole fall of potential method. The constant current source used is 10 sin ωt (mA) with a frequency of 128 Hz. The setpoint can be set to 3 - 500 W, with a hysteresis of ± 0.5 W. The data storage speed can be set to 1 - 60 data per minute and stored as a text file (DATALOG.txt). This tool was developed in the LabVIEW environment. The constant current source uses NI-9174 and NI-9265 cDAQ. The controller uses NI MyRIO-1900. As a result of realization and test, the device functions and can significantly control the grounding resistance with an effective resistance measurement error of ± 0.697%. The grounding resistance behavior can be monitored in the form of numerical and graphical data by time, via wireless on the host computer and client.

articleTitle: Prediction of Student Achievement Based on the Use of Internet Networks Using the Random Forest Method
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ICEEIE)
abstract: Students are the most frequent users of the internet network for educational purposes, such as looking up references for college assignments. In reality, in order to determine the effect of using the internet network on student achievement or the cumulative index value, it is necessary to predict student achievement results based on internet network use. A survey was distributed to students with the following indicators: number of social media, internet time usage (a week), internet usage time (a day), amount of internet usage for entertainment (a day), amount of internet usage for social media (one day), time using the internet for studying (one day), and GPA. Meanwhile, classification refers to the process of classifying an object using the Random Forest algorithm. The outcomes of these predictions can be used as a foundation for universities or departments to develop regulations or policies governing the use of Internet networks, particularly on campus. The Random Forest algorithm was used in this study to make predictions with an accuracy level of 95.08%.

articleTitle: Git-Enabled Middleware for Data Change Management on Network Devices Configuration
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ICEEIE)
abstract: The network infrastructure of numerous devices has become increasingly complex today. As the requirements change, the network infrastructure configuration also needs to adapt accordingly. Network devices have limitations in only storing configurations into files without preserving the changes made. Network device configurations undergo continuous modifications based on the existing network infrastructure needs. Despite these constant changes, there may be instances where it becomes necessary to refer back to or utilize previous configurations. Version Control System (VCS), or data change management, is a commonly employed data engineering task to track and trace changes in files, storing each alteration in a repository database as a chronological sequence of changes over time. Git is one widely used VCS. This study presents a system design that enables the versioning of network device configurations using Git, allowing for the recording of configuration changes into a server. If a previous configuration version is required, it can be retrieved from the stored change logs within the server. The experimental results demonstrate that the middleware can effectively track configuration changes stored in the repository. The middleware determines the specific version downloaded into the network devices. The time required to switch between versions ranges from three to 12 seconds based on the experiment involving 50 to 500 changes. The storage usage for a single repository, capable of storing 360 changes, amounts to six MB.

articleTitle: Goods Moving Robot Prototype Using 3-Wheel Omni-Wheel System
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ICEEIE)
abstract: In light of the recent global crisis, especially the public health emergency, traditional goods distribution systems are vulnerable to inefficiencies and gaps. Therefore, it is important to overcome this deficiency, the need for a solution, namely making technological innovations. To achieve this goal, this research introduces a revolutionary Goods Moving Robot, powered by a 3-Wheel Omni-Wheel System. Leveraging a powerful mathematical framework of kinematic and trigonometric algorithms, these autonomous robots represent a paradigm shift in goods distribution logistics. The research includes a thorough examination of wheel performance, empirical testing, and analytical models, which reveal strong evidence for the application of robots in various sectors, including healthcare logistics.

articleTitle: Improved Color Attenuation Prior for Kelud Crater Image Dehazing
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ICEEIE)
abstract: Images that contain disturbances, such as haze, are very disturbing in the visibility of the image because they experience a reduction in contrast and color. In this study, we implement a system that can remove the effects of haze or noise. Therefore, the method used is expected to remove noise efficiently. The Improved Color Attenuation Prior method uses the Color Attenuation Prior principle. The output obtained is a better visibility quality image.

articleTitle: Attendance Management System Using Face Recognition
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ICEEIE)
abstract: The attendance management system is crucial in educational bodies. Over the years, several attendance methods have been implemented, such as doing roll calls. This type of manual attendance has many flaws and can be improved. Research done on improving attendance management systems has been conducted by many people. We also aspire to improve attendance management systems by creating an automated attendance management system. A method of using face recognition to improve the attendance management system has been proposed. The face recognition of the attendance management system utilizes deep learning as its base. We tested this system on several students and asked for their feedback. The experiment subjects were satisfied by our system, and the results gathered were satisfactory as the system can recognize the students and register their attendance accordingly. This type of attendance management system could serve as an alternative and improve the flaws of manual attendance management systems.

articleTitle: Converter Design For Self-Power Sensor Of Medical Equipments
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ICEEIE)
abstract: The system for collecting wasted energy and converted into electrical energy is called an energy harvesting system. This paper focuses on the application of a boost converter to harvest leg muscle energy using a permanent magnet generator. A permanent magnet generator is a medium to convert the energy wasted from the leg muscles due to leg movements into electrical energy. The voltage result reaches 1.7Vac with a total 100 steps in 3 minutes. The output voltage generated by the permanent magnet generator is low-voltage with AC current. Therefore, there are stages of designing a rectifier and boost converter circuit in the self-power generation system. The output voltage generated from the rectifier and boost converter circuit is 5 Vdc. The 5Vdc output voltage will be supplied to the supercapacitor for storage. The supercapacitor charging takes ± 1 hour 25 minutes to full. The distance required to fully charging the supercapacitor reaches 5,500 steps on an average of 4.18 Km. Electrical energy stored in supercapacitors can be used by electronic devices such as sensors, IoT, and others.

articleTitle: Analysis of Distribution System Performance After Installation of Static Var Compensator (SVC) at the Negara Customer Service Unit of Pecangakan Feeders
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ICEEIE)
abstract: Electrical energy generated at the power plant needs to be distributed to the load center through a distribution network. The thing that becomes a concern in the distribution network is the Drop Voltage. Voltage drop is the loss of most of the voltage on a conductor or the difference in value between the voltage sent and the voltage sent. Cable length, cable diameter, capacity, and internal resistance are several factors that can cause a voltage drop. One of the impacts that occur is that the distributed voltage becomes unstable. Unstable voltage occurs in the distribution network at ULP Negara Pecangakan. Therefore, Static Var Compensator (SVC) is needed in this study to minimize the voltage drop. Simulated by placing SVC on the distribution network, it is proven to minimize the amount of voltage drop by comparing the state of the voltage drop in the field. The test was carried out on the distribution system of the Pecangakan feeder which was simulated on the software. The results of the test after installing the SVC experienced an improvement in voltage stability on the bus experiencing a Drop Voltage to an average of 3,8 %. This makes the bus that is experiencing interference to be above the tolerance limit again.

articleTitle: Loosely Coupled Approach on Web-Based Item Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ICEEIE)
abstract: The industrial revolution boosted the use of assessments as well as activities involving online-based technology. Quizizz is one of the necessary and reliable online resources in this situation, while Iteman is a legacy software for classical test theory in item analysis. The purpose of this study is to develop an application based on classical test theory in a loosely-coupled design, to compare the application with the legacy software, and to implement the application with existing online platform. The method of research carried out includes the applied approach, compatibility testing with legacy software, and connectivity application with external application. The results showed that the proposed application can be used as substitute for legacy software and have the acceptable connectivity with another web-based application. The proposed application carried out the functionality in a loosely-coupled approach.

articleTitle: Evaluation Method for Selection of OATS Location for EV Radiated Emission Measurement Based on Electromagnetic Field Scanning
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ICEEIE)
abstract: The need to test modules or electric vehicles for manufacturers is critical to ensure that their products are safe for users. Constraints of building testing room facilities that meet the standard requirements are costly and often encountered by manufacturers. A Radiated Emission (RE) electromagnetic compatibility testing of a small Autonomous Electric Vehicle (AEV) already requires at least a 10 m EMC chamber with a 3 m turning floor. A regular size AEV requires a more significant EMC chamber dimension, which is not always available. Therefore, measurements of AEV in Open Area Test Sites (OATS) for RE pre-compliance testing are preferable. This paper proposed an evaluation method to choose an OATS location for AEV RE pre-compliance testing by considering the proposed locations' electromagnetic (EM) conditions. The limit of CISPR 25 is used as a reference for the allowed EM emission of AEV. The proposed evaluation method consists of two steps; the first step is to perform EM field scanning in every alternative OATS location for the frequency ranges given in CISPR 25. The second step is to identify the measured EM field frequency, which has an EM field value of 6 dB higher than the limit shown in CISPR 25. This paper proposes an evaluation method for determining the location of radiation emission testing for electric vehicles by scanning electromagnetic fields. The initial studies that have been done show that it is possible to carry out pre-compliance testing using the proposed method with certain conditions.

articleTitle: Leukemia Cell Image Classification Using CNN: AlexNet and GoogLeNet
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ICEEIE)
abstract: Leukemia is a type of blood cancer that often causes worry and uncertainty for sufferers. This study aims to investigate the latest developments in the use of convolutional neural network (CNN) models, especially GoogLeNet and AlexNet, in classifying leukemia cell images. In this study, both models were trained and tested using previously trained leukemia image datasets. The results showed that both GoogLeNet and AlexNet had very good performance in classifying leukemia cell images. Both models achieved 100% accuracy in each training run, demonstrating outstanding ability to identify and differentiate the images. In addition, both models also show equally good results in the assessment using the confusion matrix, including precision, sensitivity, specificity, and F-score. In addition to accuracy, a comparison was also made of the time parameters required in model training. In this case, AlexNet is proven to be more efficient with a shorter training time than GoogLeNet. This shows that AlexNet can be a better choice in terms of time efficiency in model training. This research provides hope in dealing with leukemia by using deep learning technology and convolutional neural network models. The results obtained indicate the possibility of using this model in the diagnosis and classification of leukemia images accurately and efficiently. However, further research is needed to validate and test this model on a larger dataset and consider other factors that may affect model performance.

articleTitle: K-Means Algorithm in Illiteracy Clustering
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ICEEIE)
abstract: Illiteracy is a condition where a person cannot read and write to communicate and express opinions in social life. Illiteracy is a problem that exists in almost all countries, including Indonesia. Even though the illiteracy rate continues to decrease annually, several regions still have a high quantity of illiteracy. Additionally, there are fewer illiterates in any area. One way to find out the distribution of illiterate population data is to map the population based on the level of illiteracy so that it can be prioritized for handling in areas with high illiteracy rates. In data mining, the technique for mapping the illiterate population can be done using the clustering method, namely by grouping the population of each region by giving labels based on their illiterate class. This study aims to cluster illiterate population data based on their illiteracy level and find the optimal number of classes in the illiteracy level clustering process. The class clustering algorithm uses k-means clustering. This study applies three scenarios with different k values, namely k=2, k=3, and k=5. The clustering results are validated using the cluster validation process to find the optimal number of clusters with a silhouette coefficient (SC). The results showed that the SC values at k=2, k=3, and k=5 were 0.24, 0.59, and 0.35. The results of this validation show that when k=3 produces the most excellent SC value, the study concludes that k=3 is the most ideal number of clusters.

articleTitle: An Autonomous Drone for Measuring A River Width Based on K-Means Clustering
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ICEEIE)
abstract: The common method for measuring the river width is by getting two GPS coordinates from both sides of the river and calculating the distance in between. However, it is inefficient and time consuming. This paper proposed a new method by using a drone with special performance to measure the river width based on K-Means Clustering. The drone is equipped with a camera and minicomputer of Jetson Nano, with the use of Pixhawk to control the motors and stabilize drone poses. The Jetson Nano is connected to the Pixhawk via a USB cable; hence it makes Jetson Nano easily accessing the Pixhawk data such as the IMU, the GPS coordinates, and the altitude. The river width is calculated based on the color similarity of the color of water, it is extracted by K-Means clustering, then the actual river width is obtained by normalization of the river width on pixel image and drone altitude. The proposed system has been tested in real experiments with a drone flying over rivers which have five different conditions. The first test is applied to a river with sufficient water conditions, the river edge has a sloping concrete of ±7.2m wide, and an optimal height of 20m. The test has a reading error of 3.1944%. The second test is applied to a river with a sediment of±5m, and an optimal height of 35m, it has a reading error of 2%. The third test is given to a river with slightly winding and sufficient water, the optimal altitude is 35m and it has a reading error of 1%. The fourth test is given to a river with a lack of water, uneven edges, sediments, and a width of ±9m. The optimal altitude is 45m, and it gives a reading error of 0,67%. The fifth test is a river with an irregular bank of land and width of ±7.7m. The optimal altitude is 40m, and it gives a reading error of 1,039%.

articleTitle: Optimization of Digital Instrumentation of Electrical Quantities in Internet of Things Devices Using Mean Square Error
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ICEEIE)
abstract: The Internet of Things (IoT) is an essential component of the industrial era 4.0. The period of industrialization, which refers to the development of Industry 4.0, is a reincarnation of steam engines, electricity, assembly, and computerization that have changed in a short time. One of the uses of IoT is smart meters that can record and communicate data due to monitoring. Various industries have started large digitalization initiatives. Although IoT has a low cost in digitization, the ultimate success is determined by the successful implementation of new sensors. Therefore, existing requirements and constraints will compete with the performance needs defined by the application or business model that uses it. Optimization of digital measurement of electrical quantities using the PZEM-004T sensor on the ESP 8266 IoT device provides poor voltage measurement accuracy, but current measurement already has a good accuracy of 0.01. So, improving the trainer from the side of the voltage gauge circuit is necessary.

articleTitle: Development of an IoT-Based Door Security System Using Reed Switch Sensor with RFID and Telegram Notification
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ICEEIE)
abstract: Many limited spaces, such as offices, laboratories and organizational rooms, are found to utilize conventional keys for security, subsequently emphasizing a factor regarding the cases of loss or crime. This shows that various technological development processes are designed to provide security and protect owned assets. The security system also works with an electronic program to ensure difficult entrance without a key. Therefore, this study aims to develop an automatic door safety system, to increase room security. This was done using a reed switch sensor with RFID and telegram notification. In this case, the sensor used a controller and served as a detector, alerting an individual's interior and exterior mobilities through the door. The Node MCU ESP8266 was used as the controller, with RFID also utilized as a data store for users' authentication evidence.

articleTitle: Implementation of Inverse Kinematics on Arduino-Based SAR Robot Leg Design as a Control for Robot Motion Maneuverability
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ICEEIE)
abstract: The development of robotics has progressed linearly over time. There are many innovations in robot locomotion, such as the use of wheels in terms of robot mobility. However, this solution has limitations when traversing challenging terrain, such as steep or uneven surfaces. To overcome this problem, an innovation was developed that imitates the body structure and movement mechanism of ants using six legs. These robotic legs are equipped with servos, functioning similarly to joints, mirroring those found in real ants. For movement, this robot utilizes inverse kinematics, a process that takes coordinate input and translates it into the required angular degrees for its smart servos. The robotic core system is an Arduino Mega 2560 Pro microcontroller, enabling more extensive and fluid limb movements. However, the leg design must be adjusted to calculate the inverse kinematic angle to ensure the robot's body remains balanced, provide suspension to dampen unwanted vibrations, allow the robot to move freely at various tilts, and minimize the risk of damage when moving at high speeds. This research focuses on structuring the leg design and determining inverse kinematic parameters which aim to maximize robot maneuvering on uneven surfaces. The results of this research are robot realization and robot testing experiments. From the results of the inverse kinematics experiment, it was found that the average error value for the X axis for each leg was 1.64%, the Y axis was 2.61% and the Z axis was 6.88%.

articleTitle: Two Dimensional Local Positioning for Monitoring Position and Movement using UWB
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ICEEIE)
abstract: In times, there has been an increase in the demand for accurate object localization in agricultural environments. This research paper presents an approach to address this need using the DWM1000 sensor. The main goal of this study was to assess the sensor's ability to determine an object's location and track its movement precisely. To accomplish this, we equipped an object with the sensor, which collected range data from each reference sensor. Using the triangulation method, we processed this data to establish a localization system. This system offers an alternative to GPS-based positioning methods, eliminating the reliance on GPS for determining the position of a vehicle. It is worth noting that our experiments were conducted outdoors, marking a departure from the indoor applications of this sensor. Outdoor testing involved measuring distances at intervals and evaluating their performance in open environments. The results were visualized through a Graphic User Interface emphasizing the suitability of this method for agricultural purposes. This study's findings demonstrate the sensor's versatility and pave the way for its broader use in outdoor settings.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Performance of the Electric Power System at Sentani Jayapura Airport
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ICEEIE)
abstract: Distribution of electric power in a building is a power distribution circuit system starting from power sources, transformers, distribution networks to the load with all its aspects in such a way that the quality of service and comfort of the building can be maintained properly and optimally, efficiently and economically. Therefore it is necessary to analyze the performance of the electric power system at Sentani Jayapura airport. The Sentani Jayapura Airport electric power system uses a combined PLN and generator supply as a source of electric power. In this power system there are 4 transformers with 3 main transformers and 1 backup transformer. This transformer transformer is connected to the load according to the design that has been made. To find out the problems in this electric power system, an analysis is carried out. In this study, the analysis includes voltage drop and short circuit analysis. The analysis is carried out using existing specifications and systems and is carried out by performing calculations at full load. Then a simulation is carried out as a comparison of manual calculations.

articleTitle: Book Spine Matching with Library Collection Using Speeded Up Robust Features
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ICEEIE)
abstract: Misplaced books in libraries are an ongoing issue that impedes the efficient retrieval and organizing of books. However, the traditional way of regularly arranging a lot of books according to the classification number in the library costs a lot of time and the implementation of technology such as RFID (Radio Frequency Identification) is expensive. To provide insight and recommendations for libraries with the convenient and cheap method, the use of SURF (Speeded Up Robust Features) is implemented. SURF was implemented by analyzing the image data of some books on a shelf to know the location of the misplaced book when it is projected onto a bookshelf. The result, SURF could match the book spine of the misplaced book on the bookshelf. On the other hand, if it applied to the bookshelf there are a lot of similar books even though they come from different authors. It concludes that SURF could find the location of the book we want by matching the image.

articleTitle: Classification of Cyber Crime Cases in Surabaya, Indonesia Based on ITE Law Violation
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ICEEIE)
abstract: As a state of law, Indonesia is obliged to protect every citizen from harmful actions, including crimes that occur virtually, commonly called cybercrime. This paper classifies cybercrimes registered on 2021 that took place in the District Court of Surabaya to recognize which ITE law article has the highest number of violations committed by the people living in Surabaya. Information related to the verdict was obtained by accessing the official website of the local District Court. Details such as which article was violated, verdicts, and accusations are provided and can be publicly accessed. The classification commences by determining the article violated and listing the accusation given to the defendant. The results are presented in tables and graphs along with three articles that have the highest number of violations, including a brief description of the cases.

articleTitle: COVID-19 Viruses Link Prediction Using Graph Algorithms And Random Forest
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ICEEIE)
abstract: The ongoing coronavirus pandemic has caused the spread of information related to this virus to continue growing. COVID-19 mutates and gives rise to new variants. A taxonomy graph of these viruses can help us see the connections between viruses. Thus, we implemented a taxonomic graph of COVID-19 to determine the cause of the virus and its parent of origin. The virus dataset was retrieved from Wikidata. We exploited several graph algorithms to create the taxonomy graph: link prediction, triangle/grouping coefficients, and community detection algorithms. The results of the graph algorithms become the features of the Random Forest classifier. Random Forest predicts the relationship between two viruses. The research results showed average scores of accuracy, precision, and recall of 90%, 90%, and 91 %, respectively.

articleTitle: Cocoa Ripeness Level Sorting System Using Integrated Computer Vision Technology On Conveyor Belt
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ICEEIE)
abstract: Cocoa fruit is a type of plantation commodity with high economic value. With increasing production and market demand, various forms of technology are needed to support the acceleration of cocoa production and post-production. Cocoa farmers sort and determine the ripeness of cocoa fruit based on estimates from farmers. This causes post-harvest production handling to be less effective and efficient. The ripeness detection and sorting system for cocoa fruit is an innovation that can help detect ripeness and sort cocoa fruit automatically. This system is designed using the TCS3200 sensor which can read the RGB value of the skin color of the cocoa fruit, Arduino Uno, and a servo motor as a sorter for the cocoa fruit. The system built produces a sorting accuracy of 70%.

articleTitle: Developing Load-Shedding Trainer for Learning Protection System Course Department of Electrical Engineering Universitas Negeri Malang
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ICEEIE)
abstract: One of the practicum learning facilities and media is to use props or trainers. In learning the protection system course at the electrical engineering department of Universitas Negeri Malang, learning only partially uses practicum-based learning methods due to limited supporting learning media. Therefore, this study aims to design, develop, and determine the feasibility level of load-shedding trainers as learning media for protection systems courses for students of the Electrical Engineering Department, Universitas Negeri Malang. This study uses the development model which includes 10 stages of the procedure. The data collection method used instruments in the form of a questionnaire and the validation stage was carried out by two media experts, while product trials were carried out on 10 students and usage trials were carried out on 30 students. The data analysis technique of this research uses descriptive quantitative and descriptive qualitative data analysis techniques. The results of this study are in the form of learning media for load-shedding trainers equipped with job sheets. The validation results of the media expert 1 get 91.67% and the validation results of the media expert 2 get 89.58% so they are considered very valid and feasible. The results of the product trials conducted on 10 students obtained a percentage of 94.64% which was categorized as very feasible, and the results of the usage trials conducted on 30 students obtained a percentage of 93.21% which was categorized as very feasible. Based on the results of the media expert's assessment, product trials, and usage trials, the load-shedding trainer is suitable for use as a learning media for the subject of protection systems in the electrical engineering department, at Universitas Negeri Malang.

articleTitle: Football Humanoid Goalkeeper Robot Movement System Using Optimization of Head Movements
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ICEEIE)
abstract: This research is motivated by the robot which by default the program is only moved in one direction, namely forward so it is not effective to make the robot banish the ball. In the competition, the goalkeeper robot is required to block the movement of the ball to cross the goal line, the importance of the role of a keeper in the football humanoid robot competition is behind research so that the robot can move other than forward, which is to move sideways. The robot moves straight with respect to the x-axis, while the robot moves sideways with respect to the y-axis. Therefore, in the program, there is a function called setWalkingParam where there are balance, x_move, y_move, and rotation_angle parameters. The parameter to be optimized is y_move so that the robot can move sideways at a certain velocity. The trigger for the robot to move sideways is the angle of the robot's head where when the robot is detecting an object, it will simultaneously output in the form of an angle on the robot's head.

articleTitle: Designing a Transporter Mobile Robot for the WorldSkills Competition 2022 Using a Finite-State Machine Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ICEEIE)
abstract: This paper delves into the progress made in robots in competitive environments such as the WorldSkills Competition (WSC) for Mobile Robotics. The 2022 WSC focused on hospital service robots. It assigned them responsibilities, including sorting medications, delivering items to patient rooms, inspecting medical waste and moving patient gurneys. We introduce a mobile robot that utilizes three omni wheels for seamless movement in all directions. Noteworthy features of this robot include a manipulator arm and gripper for handling objects, a storage space capable of accommodating three medicine cubes and the ability to transport gurneys simultaneously. The robot employs LabVIEW as its programming medium to control its operations within a defined mission area effectively. It is equipped with the myRIO microcontroller. The Finite State Machine (FSM) approach was chosen due to its relevance to the robot's tasks and functions.

articleTitle: Achieving High Availability through Implementation of Message Queue on Document Forgery Software
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ICEEIE)
abstract: The growth and demand of falsification detection software is in tandem with the amount of data processed, thus driving the need to build a system capable of handling this amount of data. This study aims to introduce Siberpunk - a microservice-based applications using message queues to detect document forgery. This research also uses containers to support high availability. The process of testing the system in this study uses the load testing method by comparing the implementation of message queues and REST on the system being built. Load testing in research uses the help of the Apache JMeter application. The results of this study indicate that the developed system can separate the dependence of the input process on the plagiarism detection system, and the message queue performance results show that RabbitMQ has stable memory consumption and Kafka has lowest latency.

articleTitle: Compensation Analysis Voltage Sag Using Dynamic Voltage Restorer Based Artificial Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ICEEIE)
abstract: One of the power quality problems is voltage sag, that often occurs in distribution systems. Voltage sag can occur due to a phase to ground short circuit in the feeder and affect the voltage balance in feeders. The voltage can be said to be stable if the value is close to 1 pu. Voltage sag faults can cause damage to some equipment sensitive to voltage changes in the load line. To overcome these disturbances, an effective compensation device is needed, namely the Dynamic Voltage Restorer (DVR). The DVR is placed in series between the feeder line and the sensitive load. The ability of the DVR to detect and compensate for voltage is influenced by the control system. a control system is an Artificial Neural Network added to the DVR because it has the effectiveness and speed of voltage compensation. The results of the DVR simulation for compensating for voltage flicker due to short-circuit phase to ground obtained compensation results of 0.96 pu, two-phase short-circuit to the ground of 0.99 pu, and three-phase short-circuits to the ground of 0.992 pu.

articleTitle: Measuring the Level of e-Commerce Usability in the Electrical and Informatics Engineering Department Using the System Usability Scale
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ICEEIE)
abstract: In this study, Tech Zone Plaza conducted a testing phase using the system usability scale method, which is used with the aim of measuring how good a user experience is from software. The results of this test is used as a reference for improving and adjusting the user interface based on the result and input from the test. Testing Tech Zone Plaza e-commerce uses System Usability Scale (SUS) Methods. There are several steps that must be followed in conducting a system usability scale. The steps are divided into 3 parts, Preparation, Execution, and Analysis The overall average SUS score is 74, on a scale of 0 to 100, indicating a moderately positive perception of the system's usability. According to the findings of this study, SUS ratings and individual responder feedback provide essential information for evaluating the system's usability. They serve as critical indications of strengths and shortcomings, highlighting areas for improvement and informing decision-making to improve the user experience. A full knowledge of the system's usability may be obtained by supplementing quantitative data from SUS scores with qualitative input from users, resulting in a system that better matches user expectations and requirements.

articleTitle: Implementation of Inverse Kinematics to Perform Walking Movements on Raspiberry-Pi Humanoid Robot
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ICEEIE)
abstract: Humanoid robots are robots with human-like physiology and behavior. Humanoid robots, like sentient humans, have servos that control the orientation of their limbs. For humanoid robots, inverse kinematics optimization is required to compute the angular mass of the robot legs in their implementation. Angular mass is found based on the desired position of the robot. Optimization is a calculation that finds the closest numerical approximation to the servos to ensure that the robot's leg movements are error-free. The reason is that the leg movements of humanoid robots are not efficient without the use of inverse kinematics. Ultimately, the servo torque in the robot's legs will be excessive and the servos will overheat, potentially fatal to the robot. Using the inverse kinematics formula, the authors optimize the leg angle in degrees based on the desired limb position. A Raspberry Pi is used to support the more complex robot microcontrollers, which can easily move their legs in any direction.

articleTitle: Telecare Device System Based on Patient Body Temperature
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ICEEIE)
abstract: This research focuses on the development of a room temperature control prototype based on the patient's body temperature, designed specifically for telecare patients who require a certain room temperature. The prototype is created through the stages of planning, design, testing, and evaluation. Black box testing is employed to ensure that all components function as expected. The study results in two devices: a wearable device connected to the patient and a room control device responsible for regulating the blower and window opening/closing mechanisms. The communication distance between these devices is up to 900 cm, and the room control device can detect the patient within a range of 600 cm. The blower and window can be operated to adjust the room temperature to either cold, normal, or warm conditions as desired.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Fault Current Limiter (FCL) Againts Short Circuit Current at Pecangan Feeder Unit Customer Service Negara
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ICEEIE)
abstract: The level of reliability of an electric power system must meet technical standards and must be able to cope with disturbances that can occur at any time. Short circuit current disturbance is one of the most common disturbances in an electric power system. The disturbances that occur are usually caused by short circuit faults from phase to ground or short circuit faults between phases. Many factors cause short circuit current disturbances, including human error or negligence, disturbances from within the system such as obsolete equipment, as well as disturbances from natural factors such as being hit by a lightning strike, being hit by a fallen tree, and so on. As was the case at the Pecangakan of ULP NEGARA, to overcome this, an analysis of short circuit faults needs to be carried out in order to determine a protection system. By studying the contribution of the fault current flowing at the time of the disturbance. One tool that can reduce short circuit current disturbance is the Fault Current Limiter (FCL). However, it is necessary to evaluate the capacity of the current-limiting reactor to be used so as not to cause negative impacts, one of which is the occurrence of a voltage drop. By calculating the FCL capacity, the short circuit current disturbance that occurs can be reduced with the FCL rating that has been calculated according to the value of the fault current that occurs. The results After installing the FCL, the short circuit current disturbance on each bus was shown to decrease between 52.4%–98% for each bus.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Web Admin Based Indoor Localization for the Visually Impaired with Real-Time Monitoring Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ICEEIE)
abstract: Indoor Localization is a location-based service that focuses on enclosed spaces; which is a weakness of Global Positioning System (GPS). This technology can be used to monitor the positions of people who are blind or visually impaired who are within certain space indoors. Visually impaired people may have difficulties in identifying obstacles or any other items that may be on their paths while walking. Thus, this research proposes to design and develop a web-based administrator application that can show the positions of blind people within certain spaces. This application will be built using adonisJS framework and WebSocket technologies. These technologies will provide real-time data. The application was developed using Scrum approach. The application's usability was then evaluated using WebQual questionnaire and Likert scale. The result was 481 with an average of 4.00, which falls under the acceptable category.

articleTitle: Performance Evaluation of EfficientNetB0, EfficientNetV2, and MobileNetV3 for American Sign Language Classification
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ICEEIE)
abstract: Sign language is a type of communication system that involves the gestures of our hands and our facial expressions to communicate with people who are deaf. Unfortunately, it is estimated that 1.5 billion people in the world have this disability. The task of sign language identification has attracted a lot of scientific attention over the years, resulting in advancements and insightful findings to the field. In keeping with the ongoing search for enhanced accuracy and efficiency, our research examines the utility of transfer learning by using pre-trained CNN models, notably EfficientNetB0, EfficientNetV2, and MobileNetV3. Our main goal is to compare and assess how well these models perform when it comes to the recognition of American Sign Language (ASL). The dataset used consists of a varied collection of 13,000 photos divided into 29 different ASL groups. In this endeavor, we find that EfficientNetB0, MobileNetV3, and EfficientNetV2 have accuracy rates of 99.54%, 93.93%, and 74.62%, respectively. These findings shed substantial insight into these models' potential to advance ASL recognition technology.

articleTitle: E-Module to Grow Interest in Learning Multimedia Engineering for Informatics Engineering Students
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ICEEIE)
abstract: Interactive e-modules use information technology to attract student learning interest. Multimedia Engineering is a compulsory subject for PTI UM undergraduate students. This course is suitable for teaching in vocational high schools with multimedia, VCD and broadcasting skills. Based on observations, the teaching materials used in the form of PDF modules and video links are not interesting and interactive so that they make students uninterested and bored. The purpose of this research and development is to develop and determine the feasibility of flipbook-based electronic modules, as well as to determine students' interest in learning after using this flipbook-based electronic module. In order to foster student interest in studying this multimedia engineering course. The development method used is the result of a simplification by the Puslitjaknov team. The results of the media expert's assessment reached 96.67% which was still very good. The results of the expert review of the material reached 96.67% which is still very good. The feasibility percentage obtained from small-scale trials is 90.30% or very feasible. The feasibility percentage obtained from large-scale trials was 90.83% or very feasible. The percentage of interest in learning is 88.94% or very high interest in learning is obtained at the interest in learning test stage after using interactive electronic modules.

articleTitle: Enhancing Precision Agriculture Through PSO-Enabled Drones: Targeted Pest Control in Indonesian Rice Cultivation
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ICEEIE)
abstract: This study presents an application of aerial vehicles (UAVs), commonly known as drones, integrated with computer vision technology to detect and treat pests in precision agriculture. The focus is on rice cultivation in Indonesia, where pest infestations have contributed to a decline in the area. To address this issue, the paper proposes an approach that combines the Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) model with Visible Atmospherically Resistant Index (VARI) imaging. This combination allows for targeted spraying in areas identified as infested by pests, significantly improving efficiency. Drawing inspiration from the behavior of birds flocking or fish schooling, PSO, a stochastic technique based on population, utilizes a set of particles to evolve and find the optimum through iterative processes. Each particle, characterized by its velocity and position, navigates towards areas based on its best fitness value, thereby determining an optimal path for the drone. The effectiveness of PSO has been previously demonstrated in path planning for plantations and coconut detection for harvesting, highlighting its versatility. This research contributes to the community by showcasing the efficacy of utilizing PSO within UAVs for pest management and optimizing spraying operations. However, it should be noted that certain limitations exist, such as identifying one area and encountering challenges when translating paths into real-world conditions. Moving forward, researchers can direct their efforts toward addressing these obstacles to maximize the potential of UAVs in Precision Agriculture.

articleTitle: Flight Dynamics and Dual Front Rotor Tilt Mechanism for a Quad Plane UAV
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ICEEIE)
abstract: This paper presents a quad-plane tilt-rotor innovation, representing an advancement in Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) design. The quad plane boasts improvements in crucial aspects, including motor placement, motor count, airfoil selection, vehicle typology, and wing and tail configurations. One of the standout features highlighted in our study is its ability to conduct mapping designed explicitly for detailed plant health analysis. What sets it apart is its take-off capability that eliminates the need for launch areas and provides unmatched flexibility during deployment. When operating in fixed-wing mode, the quad plane excels in surveillance missions by ensuring data recording is automatically stored on an SD Card to maintain data integrity from take-off to landing. We employ a PID control method further supported by an IMU sensor to ensure stability during flight control. Integrating a GPS guarantees accuracy by processing satellite-derived radio signals to determine latitude and longitude information. With a flight duration of 15 minutes and reliable control outcomes, the UAV is a game changer in aerial surveillance applications. The quad-plane tilt rotor is more than a technological achievement; it has the potential to completely transform agricultural methods in Indonesia, tackling the issues of diminishing yields and rice production. Our research indicates that this unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) is on the verge of establishing benchmarks in monitoring and analysis.

articleTitle: A Comparative Analysis of Machine Learning Approaches for Chronic Kidney Disease Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ICEEIE)
abstract: In performing tests and diagnosing illness in healthcare, symptom experiment processes are used to detect the fundamental cause of syndromes. In this research, we employed a crossbred technique to develop our mentioned ideal model, which improvd Pearson correlation for the purpose of feature selection. The initial phase involved choosing the ideal models through critical analysis of the literature. Subsequently, our proposed hybrid model incorporated a combination of these models. The base classifiers used in XGBoost, Random Forest, Logistic Regression, AdaBoost and Hybrid model classifiers, while the Meta classifier was the random forest classifier. Mainly the goal of this experiment is to assess the most useful machine learning classification methods and predict the optimal classifier in terms of precision. This makes amends for the problem of overfitting and attains the best level of accuracy. The focus of the evaluation is on accuracy, and a detailed analysis of the relevant literature is presented in a tabular format. To implementation, we used four best-performing ML models and developed a new model named hybrid utilizing the UCI Chronic Kidney Failure dataset for predictive purposes. An XGBoost classifier achieves about 98% accuracy, a random forest achieves 97% accuracy, Logistic Regression about 94% accuracy, AdaBoost achieves 95% accuracy, and our proposed new model named hybrid achieves the highest 99% accuracy, and it performs best on the same dataset. Several prominent machine learning models utilized to predict the onset of CKF (chronic kidney failure) include Naïve Bayes, Random Forest, Decision Tree, Support Vector Machine, K-nearest neighbor, LDA, GB, and neural network. Within our research, XGBoost, AdaBoost, Logistic Regression, random forest, and hybrid models are used for the same dataset of features for comparison of accuracy scores.

articleTitle: Connectivity of Agricultural Soil Fertility Online Monitoring Devices with Smartphones
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ICEEIE)
abstract: Rice yields are highly dependent on the level of soil fertility in agricultural areas. This condition is also supported because there are no pests that attack rice plants. In addition, the level of soil fertility determines the amount of rice yields for farmers. The level of soil fertility is influenced by several factors such as soil pH level, soil temperature, and soil moisture. Weather that often changes can cause the level of soil fertility to also fluctuate. The level of soil fertility can be better or worse than the previous condition. Excessive solar heat can cause the soil to dry out and the soil temperature to increase so that the level of soil fertility decreases. When it rains, the soil moisture level increases, the soil temperature decreases, and the soil pH decreases. Therefore, we need a device that can monitor the level of soil fertility online and based on the Internet of Things (IoT) during real time weather conditions. The device is equipped with a pH sensor, temperature sensor, and soil moisture sensor. The sensors are connected to a microprocessor to process the measurement data. In the process of sending data, additional equipment is needed to connect the microcontroller to the internet network, so that the data that has been processed by the microprocessor can be sent to the smartphone. The smartphone displays information about the level of soil fertility, soil temperature, soil pH, and soil moisture levels in real time. The online monitoring device has been successfully tested and can help farmers to find out the real-time condition of their agricultural land accurately and quickly.

articleTitle: Environmental Mapping Automation by Quadruped Robot Using Lidar Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ICEEIE)
abstract: Navigation as well as mapping using robots is currently widely used in various fields. Automated robot navigation and mapping allows robots to provide information about their surroundings to humans more effectively. LiDAR is one of the latest technologies used to carry out environmental mapping. The implementation of LiDAR technology coupled with legged robots is useful for autonomously mapping environments that have uneven trajectories, such as on the ground, rocky areas, and grass. Quadruped robot is a type of legged robot that is used in research and operations in the industrial world or in observing certain environmental areas. Determining the appropriate gait according to the observed characteristics of the robot and the environment, selecting the algorithm for mapping, and presenting the visualization of the map must be met for the success of the mapping process. This research applies Hector SLAM, crawl gait, trot gait, and the use of LiDAR technology to map the artificial environment which is carried out autonomously by a quadruped robot with the aim of obtaining information in the form of an environmental map which is visualized using RViz. The implementation of crawl gait to move forward is considered the most suitable for the quadruped robot in this research because the load being lifted is quite heavy, namely ±1.5kg, while the implementation of a dynamic trot gait is used to turn left or right. The result of this research is that the quadruped robot is able to walk through a well-defined environment and draw a complete map of the observed artificial environment with an accuracy rate of 97%.

articleTitle: Edu-Kit Arm Robot with Protocol Data for Robotics Course
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ICEEIE)
abstract: One of the elective courses available to undergraduate Electrical Engineering Education is robotics. The learning outcomes of this course is to be able designing a robot. Then, it is necessary to design Edu-kit for teaching arm robots in industrial control systems, particularly in the areas of data transfer protocols. The purpose of developing this Edu-kits is to introduce how to program robot with protocol data. The Edu-kit is accomplished with product of arm robot prototype and job sheets. The product and job sheet are validated by two exerts regarding to media and material side. The Edu-kit product's validation results can be satisfied for 92.36% of the media's indicators and 95.66% of the material's indicators. Regarding the validation of work sheets, the findings indicate that 91.37% and 93.06% of the material's indicator and 93.35% and 96.53% of the media's indicator, respectively, are fulfilled. Furthermore, the use of product and job sheets are evaluated. In case of product trial, 90.50% and 91.29% of the participants were stated that the product was eligible. Then, the job sheets and the product were implemented and the eligibility percentages were 90.54% and 90.89%, respectively. It's indicate that the product and job sheet's feasibility level are high valid to be used.

articleTitle: Classification Based on Texture Analysis for Synthetic Hazy Image from Mount Kelud Haze Image Density
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ICEEIE)
abstract: This paper classifies the simulations of homogeneous synthetic images, heterogeneous synthetic hazy images, and original hazy images taken from CCTV (Close Circuit Television) of Mt. Kelud crater using the GLCM (Gray Level Co-Occurrence Matrix) method. The average feature values obtained using the GLCM (Gray Level Co-Occurrence Matrix) method are used to compare the similarity of gray feature values of the three and then classify thin, medium, and thick images. The results for classifying thin haze, medium haze, and thick haze on the homogeneous synthetic hazy image test data obtained an accuracy value of 50%, a precision value of 46%, and a sensitivity value of 65%. As for the classification of thin, medium, and thick fog on heterogeneous synthetic hazy images, test data obtained an accuracy value of 42%, a precision value of 32%, and a sensitivity value of 48%.

articleTitle: Hybrid of Neural Prophet and Attention-Based LSTM for Container Freight Rate Forecasting
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ICEEIE)
abstract: Time series forecasting has been widely employed in diverse industries, including finance, retail, healthcare, and maritime forecasting. Achieving accurate forecasts in these applications, particularly in the maritime industry, is crucial but challenging. Due to its superiority over a single model, hybridization between many models has begun to develop to enhance model performance. This study introduces a new hybrid forecasting approach that combines the recently developed Neural Prophet (NP) model and the Attention-Based Long-Short-Term-Memory (LSTM) model. The proposed method is designed to predict container freight rates. This proposed model will be compared, discussed, and evaluated with different performance metrics later. The result found that the proposed hybrid model shows the good performance of least performance metrics of MAE and MSE values of 0.0261 and 0.00087 for CCFI, 0.165 and 0.037 for SCFI compared to a single model of Neural Prophet. For MAPE, only the Drewry dataset in the proposed method has the least value of 0.028 compared to a single model of Neural Prophet.

articleTitle: An Alternative Learning Management System to Improve the Learning Accessibility of Merdeka Curriculum
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ICEEIE)
abstract: This research aims to developing a learning management system (LMS) based on a local network to improve student learning access in the Informatics subject. The LMS is design to address the challenges faced by students in using the Merdeka Curriculum, which includes difficulties in finding appropriate learning materials, limited internet connectivity, and reduced motivation to learn. The proposed solution aims to create an engaging and accessible platform for students to access educational resources seamlessly. The development methodology employed is the 4D model, encompassing four key phases: Define, Design, Develop, and Disseminate. A web-based mobile learning application is developed, featuring essential components such as a homepage, materials section, discussion forum, and quizzes. The website's dynamic nature, built using Flask and Web view, allows for easy content updating without affecting the application's functionality. The study seeks to assess the feasibility of the learning media and gauge its impact on student learning access. By adopting a local network-based LMS, this research endeavors to revolutionize the way students access educational resources, making learning a more engaging and efficient process in the field of Informatics. The results of the student learning access test showed a percentage of 84.10% with very high criteria. This shows the effect of implementing a learning management system on the ease of access to student learning. Therefore, the media is considered appropriate and can be used as one of the supporting media for learning in informatics subjects at Vocational School.

articleTitle: The Implementation of Peer Tutoring Learning Model with E-Learning Media to Improve Students' Learning Outcomes in Fundamental of Electrical Engineering at State Vocational High School 1 Sidoarjo
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ICEEIE)
abstract: The teacher is a facilitator in the learning process and has a vital role in providing a learning experience for students' development. One of the alternatives to implementing a learning method is peer tutoring. It is employed by making mini group work. This research was conducted to see the efficiency of the peer tutoring learning method's implementation in increasing students' learning outcomes in the tenth grade of Electrical Installation Engineering (TITL) at State Vocational Senior High School (SMKN) 1 Sidoarjo in the Fundamentals of Electrical Engineering subject. The method of this study is Classroom Action Research (CAR) with a descriptive quantitative design. The results showed that the implementation of peer tutoring increased students' learning outcomes and gave efficient results.

articleTitle: The Effect of Data Splitting Ratio and Vectorizer Method on the Accuracy of the Support Vector Machine and Naïve Bayes Model to Perform Sentiment Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ICEEIE)
abstract: The main information retrieved from public opinions can be understood by carrying out a sentiment analysis. The validity of the retrieved information depends on the performance of the algorithm used to perform the sentiment analysis., where sentiment analysis parameters themselves need to be considered. Thus, it is important to determine the best level parameter and algorithm in order to obtain a valid conclusion from a sentiment analysis. This study aims to determine the effect of the data splitting ratio (0.5, 0.6, 0.7), and vectorizer (CountVectorizer, TF-IDF) on the accuracy of the Support Vector Machine and Naïve Bayes model while performing sentiment analysis. The results of the research show that the data splitting ratio and vectorizer have a significant effect on the accuracy of the SVM and Naïve Bayes model performance. However, the interaction between the data splitting ratio and the vectorizer method does not significantly influence the accuracy of both models.

articleTitle: Intolerant Analysis: A Proposed Method for Measuring Intolerance Level in Text-Based Social Media Profiles
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ICEEIE)
abstract: Intolerance is a problem that arises with the development of social media. These problems sometimes arise if they are related to elements of ethnicity, religion, race, or certain groups. According to some literature, in general, intolerance is a person's feeling that they cannot accept other groups in public discussions that occur on social media. Many researchers have carried out sentiment analysis but have not studied intolerance analysis, even though, in many cases, intolerance is often characterized by negative sentiment or even hate speech. In this study, a classification of intolerance sentences using machine learning is proposed. Furthermore, several calculations of the level and percentage of intolerance for a social media account are also described. The accuracy of machine learning calculations is 97% for intolerance analysis. The calculation of the percentage of intolerance for a social media account is obtained from the number of data dictionaries (corpus) that appear in all text posts. So, the percentage level of intolerance can be calculated to categorize the level of intolerance of a social media account based on text.

articleTitle: CNN Image Classification Model Comparison Between Single-Label and Multi-Label CAPTCHA Dataset
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ICEEIE)
abstract: CAPTCHA is a digital security system that prevents automated bots from accessing an online website or service. With the advancements in Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN), CAPTCHA can be easily bypassed with the correct model and dataset. Using deep learning methods to bypass various types of CAPTCHAs have been researched in previous related papers, while our paper will focus specifically on the image CAPTCHA called reCAPTCHA. This research addresses a gap in existing literature surrounding the effects of utilizing multi-labeled images compared to single-labeled images. To facilitate this endeavor, this research provides a new Multi-Label Image CAPTCHA dataset labeled and collected manually by the researchers.
