Using a public dataset alongside the newly collected dataset, this paper aims to compare and provide data on the success rate of CNN models trained using two different approaches. The first approach is training the model using a public dataset of single-labeled images acquired from Kaggle. The second approach uses the new dataset that can have multiple labels in each image. The researchers deployed the created models on a reCAPTCHA demonstration website and documented the results.

articleTitle: Ensemble-Based Prediction Model for Enhanced Electronics Engineering Licensure Examination Results Using Student Performance Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ICEEIE)
abstract: This research focuses on analyzing the impact of Electronics Engineering graduates' performance in licensure examinations on the overall quality of Higher Education Institutions (HEIs). Data mining techniques, specifically classification, are employed to examine patterns within academic performance data and predict the success of graduates in licensure examinations. The findings aim to enhance the understanding of factors influencing licensure examination performance and guide institutions in improving their instructional strategies and curriculum design. The research aims to improve prediction accuracy by training and testing different models and optimizing their hyperparameters. The ensemble model emerges as the best-performing model, combining the predictions of multiple models and achieving high accuracy rates of 95.33% and 98% in the 70:30 and 80:20 data splitting ratios, respectively. This research contributes to the application of data mining techniques in educational settings, particularly in analyzing Electronics Engineering licensure examination performance. It provides valuable insights for HEIs in evaluating and enhancing their educational programs to better prepare students for professional practice.

articleTitle: Development of Interactive Media Learning Basic Computer and Telecommunication Network Techniques for Vocational High School Students
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ICEEIE)
abstract: Learning media is everything that is used to assist teachers in the learning process in achieving learning goals. Learning media also plays a role in supporting the quality of the learning process. At this time, many learning media used by teachers are still passive with minimal interaction. With the existence of learning media that is still being passive, students are reluctant to carry out learning. There fore, an interactive learning media is needed so that students are more interested to participate in learning. The purpose of this development research is to develop an interactive learning media that can increase students' interest in learning in the basic subject of Computer Network Engineering and Telecommunications. In addition, this study also aims to determine the feasibility of interactive learning media. As well as analyzing student learning interests in participating in learning. The research and development method used in this study uses a 4D model which has 4 stages including 1) Define, 2) Design, 3) Develop, 4) Disseminate. The research and development that has been carried out has yielded results in the form of learning media products in the form of websites that can be accessed online. This product received a very decent rating from media experts with a score of 89.09%. The assessment from the material experts got a score of 93.33 % or very decent. Small group testing gets a score of 88.40% or very decent. Large group testing gets a score of 91.41 % or very decent. To increase interest in learning to get a value of 29.25. After using learning media products get a value of 43.86. Where interest in learning has increased after using products that have been developed with a gain value of 0.70. With the results that have been obtained, the purpose of developing this interactive learning media has been achieved. In the future, it is hoped that this product can be disseminated more widely and utilized by teachers and students in carrying out learning. In addition, it is also added with relevant material and features according to existing needs and developments.

articleTitle: Recommender Selection System for the Game Using Bonferroni Mean Based TOPSIS
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ICEEIE)
abstract: In this paper, a recommendation system is applied to the motor selection menu in the game “Blar Rising”. This recommendation feature is provided in the selection menu to replace the commonly used randomize feature in many games. The recommendation feature takes into account each criterion of the available motors. The determination of weights is done using the ROC method, which considers the level of importance of the criteria. Therefore, in the game, there is a selection of tracks used to differentiate the importance level for weight determination. From the results obtained, in this case, both the TOPSIS and TOPSIS-BM methods exhibit good performance in making decisions. In its implementation, Bonferroni Mean (BM) is used to generalize the Technique for Order of Preference by Similarity to Ideal Solution (TOPSIS) method. This can be observed from the difference in the results for each alternative. The TOPSIS-BM method yields similar results for each alternative, while the original TOPSIS method shows significant differences. Generalization makes the results more stable and capable of handling situations where criteria have extreme values. Usability testing across five aspects yielded an overall score of 3.43, with individual ratings for learnability (2.95), efficiency (3.87), memorability (3.67), error (3.20), and satisfaction (3.45). This suggests favorable usability acceptance among players for the recommendation feature.

articleTitle: Transforming an EROS Humanoid Soccer Robot: A Study of Velocity Input and IMU-Managed Heading
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ICEEIE)
abstract: This study redefines the navigation of humanoid soccer robots by incorporating velocity input and heading, akin to controls utilized in mobile robotics. Leveraging ZMP (Zero Moment Point) and IMU (Inertial Measurement Unit) data, a critical segue into velocity-controlled locomotion was achieved. Key insights into the applied velocity, mode of direction, and heading manipulation offered enhanced intention-oriented navigation and precise alignment capabilities. Enhanced by this methodology, the robotic maneuverability transcended to a new standard, showcasing improved agility, stability, and scoring efficacy. These transformations assert the possibility of bridging the gap between humanoid and mobile robotics, revolutionizing the sphere of humanoid soccer robotics and beyond. The result of our experiment experienced demonstrates enhanced robustness and agility features in humanoid soccer robots demonstrating effective improvements rendered with this approach. Our study further fostered progress in robotics research conducting concerning autonomous' system improvement soccer playing among humanoid soccer robots concerned with advanced techniques for modeling and enhancing walking dynamics.

articleTitle: Geospatial Analysis and Mapping of Natural Disasters in Situbondo, Indonesia: A Simple Additive Weighting (SAW) Approach *
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ICEEIE)
abstract: This study presents a Geographic Information System (GIS) based system utilizing the Simple Additive Weighting (SAW) method for mapping natural disasters in Situbondo, Indonesia. Within the Ring of Fire along the Pacific tectonic plate boundary, Indonesia is highly prone to various natural disasters, including tsunamis, volcanic eruptions, floods, and earthquakes. However, there is currently a lack of comprehensive disaster mapping and limited availability of online information through the official website of the Situbondo District Regional Disaster Management Agency (BPBD). The proposed system accurately maps the distribution of natural disaster occurrences by analyzing multiple criteria such as topography, proximity to water bodies, population density, land cover, and infrastructure. The system achieved an impressive accuracy rate of 91,8 % by comparing its results with expert evaluations. By leveraging the SAW method, decision-makers can prioritize resources and allocate them to high-risk areas, improving disaster preparedness, response planning, and mitigation strategies. This GIS-based system offers a powerful tool for Situbondo District and BPBD to make informed decisions and proactively manage natural disasters. By enhancing the availability of accurate and up-to- date information, this system supports better coordination and allocation of resources during emergencies, contributing to the overall resilience of Situbondo District and its ability to mitigate the impacts of natural disasters.

articleTitle: Statistical Analysis to Reveal Factors Affecting Cryptocurrency Prices in Commodity Futures Trading and Stock Market
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ICEEIE)
abstract: Cryptocurrency has become one of the most widely used digital investment instruments worldwide. In simple terms, cryptocurrency is a digital currency. Cryptocurrencies are not available in physical forms, such as coins or cash, but are commonly used worldwide. In cryptocurrency, everything is completely virtual. Even so, this digital money has a fairly high value. In 2017, its market capitalization reached 18 billion USD. In addition, cryptocurrencies carry a very high risk due to the problem of very fast and irregular price changes. Therefore, a study on the link between cryptocurrency and other commodities is required. Thus, data with a strong correlation may be used to judge cryptocurrency transactions. As a result, in this study, we employ the Pearson Correlation to determine the association of cryptocurrencies with various datasets, including gold, oil and natural gas, and the Nasdaq stock market. Consequently, the Nasdaq stock market dataset outperforms the others in terms of correlation, with the greatest value on the Google index of 0.91 and 0.92 on bitcoin and Ethereum. Regarding oil and natural gas, Ethereum has the greatest value versus crude oil (at 0.74), while bitcoin is at 0.61.

articleTitle: UX Design of Digital Marketing Management System for Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises to Increase Culinary Potential of Malang City
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ICEEIE)
abstract: The development of digital technology has changed the paradigm of life and fostering new ways of working in the community. Economic activities have shifted to digital form with the presence of social media and marketplaces. Based on data quoted from We are Social, it is known that as many as 170 million people (61.8% of the total population in Indonesia) are active social media users in Indonesia. Thus, the use of social media as a digital branding platform is very attractive and promising. In addition, the era of digital technology disruption makes digital branding and marketing skills very important for digital business people. Thus, digital branding learning needs to be encouraged to increase the competitiveness of the digital era. However, the absence of a platform that has special features for learning digital branding management is a problem. Therefore, as an effort to create a virtual branding application, UI/UX design efforts are needed using a design thinking approach.

articleTitle: Virtual Entrepreneurship Laboratory Development to Optimize Vocational Entrepreneurship Subject
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ICEEIE)
abstract: Entrepreneurship is a material that requires patience and tenacity in studying it which is difficult for students to get in life in a school environment. They have to learn the steps in starting a business that they don't even understand the flow of. With the existence of a virtual entrepreneurship laboratory, it is hoped that students can quickly gain knowledge and relationships from the business they have built. The development of this virtual entrepreneurship laboratory uses a Human-Centered Design approach where this method solves problems by prioritizing tenants (students) and experts (teachers) as the center and program implementation. This approach is most suitable for use in the development of virtual laboratory applications because in this virtual laboratory it prioritizes the role of students as tenants and teachers as experts, they are the ones who play the most part in this application so that if there is a problem the developer can involve tenants and experts who act on the application to solve user problems. Based on the research results conducted by taking data from an expert judgment that the development of a virtual entrepreneurship laboratory is feasible to be tested, the media results obtained are 86.25%. In the future, the development of this virtual laboratory is expected to help and support businesses that students are starting according to their talents and interests.
